facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, ICT and Media's sector strategy, dated Bujumbura February 2021, is titled as implementing the national development plan PND Burundi 2018-2027 and covers the ICT, media and postal subsectors; the period end is taken from that title, the passages state no separate period.
